<a id="page-desktop-link"></a>

## About this page

*Only in the browser extension.*

Connects this extension to the WM Pass desktop app on this computer, so it uses the vault already open there and you unlock once.

#### How it works

In the desktop app, open Settings, Browser extension, turn on **Let the extension connect** and choose **Set up browsers**. Then choose [Connect](/guide/settings/desktop-link/#action-link-connect) here.

Everything between the two is encrypted, and the relay program the browser starts in the middle cannot read it.

The first fill on each site asks in the desktop app, unless that is turned off there.

See also [Connecting the extension](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-bridge), [Connect](/guide/settings/desktop-link/#action-link-connect), [Offer to save logins](/guide/settings/desktop-link/#action-offer-save).

<a id="action-link-connect"></a>

## Connect

*Only in the browser extension.*

Starts the link to the desktop app.

#### How it works

The first time, this page and the desktop app both show a six-digit code. If they match, choose **They match** here and in the app. If they differ, choose **They differ**: something else is listening.

Each side commits to its half of the code before it sees the other's, so someone in the middle has one chance in a million of making the codes agree.

After that, the extension remembers the app's key and connects without a code.

#### Limits

If it says the app is closed or this browser has not been set up from it, start the app and choose **Set up browsers** there.

**Disconnect** forgets the app. Connecting again means comparing a code again.

See also [Desktop app](/guide/settings/desktop-link/), [Connecting the extension](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-bridge).

<a id="action-offer-save"></a>

## Offer to save logins

*Only in the browser extension.*

After you sign in somewhere new, or with a changed password, a small bar offers to save the login or update it.

#### How it works

It saves into the extension's own vault, and only while that vault is open. Logins are not offered to the desktop app's vault.

See also [Desktop app](/guide/settings/desktop-link/), [Filling logins](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-autofill).
